title: What to pack for a one-night work trip
summary: Tomorrow's clothes, a charger, and whatever the meeting actually needs — leave the rest at home.

blocks.title: Clothes for tomorrow, charger, badge
blocks.body: One night away means you wear today's clothes home. Pack what tomorrow requires and the two things that strand you without them: a phone charger and whatever gets you into the building.

items.label: Tomorrow's outfit, folded once
items.detail: Shirt, pants, underwear, socks. One of each. Ironing at the hotel is optional; packing a second shirt is usually not.

items.label: Phone charger and cable
items.detail: The hotel clock radio is not a plan.

items.label: Badge, laptop, and the one notebook you use
items.detail: If the meeting needs a printed handout, that goes in too. Everything else stays.

items.label: Toothbrush and a travel toothpaste
items.detail: Hotels often stock soap. They rarely stock a brush you like.

blocks.title: What does not come
blocks.body: Backup shoes, a full toiletry bag, gym clothes you will not use, and the novel you will not open. One night is not a camping trip.
